items.statement: Both named fragments are optimized with a stated protocol and the submitted validation evidence supports minima or a documented bounded failure.
items.expected: Per-fragment optimization and minimum-test evidence is present, with fragment IDs preserved.

items.statement: The two fragment properties are computed on consistently defined validated structures and the comparison protocol is explicit.
items.expected: The report identifies both structures, method, dipole definition and comparison basis.

items.statement: The methoxy-bearing EPI2 fragment has a lower dipole magnitude than EPI1, approximately 1.9036 D versus 2.2223 D under the paper reference protocol.
items.expected: Reported values and comparison support a reduction, allowing method/conformer caveats.

items.statement: The hydroxyl oxygen in EPI2 has less negative ESP than EPI1 in the paper analysis, consistent with reduced local polarity.
items.expected: If ESP is reported, EPI2 is less negative than EPI1; otherwise the limitation is explicit.
